idempiere.Name: 2Pack_1.0.23
idempiere.Description: REST API v2 authentication SysConfig defaults
idempiere.Author: Casa del Software

AD_SysConfig.Name: REST_MFA_CHALLENGE_EXPIRATION_SECONDS
AD_SysConfig.Description: Lifetime in seconds of an MFA authentication challenge. Client-specific values may override this default.

AD_SysConfig.Name: REST_CONTEXT_CHALLENGE_EXPIRATION_SECONDS
AD_SysConfig.Description: Lifetime in seconds of a progressive authentication context challenge. Client-specific values may override this default.

AD_SysConfig.Name: REST_MFA_MAX_ATTEMPTS
AD_SysConfig.Description: Maximum failed TOTP validation attempts before the authentication challenge is blocked. Client-specific values may override this default.

AD_SysConfig.Name: REST_V1_AUTH_ENABLED
AD_SysConfig.Description: Master switch for POST and PUT /api/v1/auth/tokens. Set to N to require the API v2 authentication flow.
